buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then BIZMIND_VERCEL_STANDBY_APPROVED=true BIZMIND_STANDBY_RELEASE_SHA="$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" node scripts/build-vercel.mjs; else node scripts/build-vercel.mjs; fi
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then echo "VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_ALLOWED=main auto-sync"; exit 1; else node scripts/ignore-vercel-deployment.mjs; fi
